title: BiHDTrans: binary hyperdimensional transformer for efficient multivariate time series classification
abstract: arXiv:2509.24425v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The proliferation of Internet-of-Things (IoT) devices has led to an unprecedented volume of multivariate time series (MTS) data, requiring efficient and accurate processing for timely decision-making in resource-constrained edge environments. Hyperdimensional (HD) computing, with its inherent efficiency and parallelizability, has shown promise in classification tasks but struggles to capture complex temporal patterns, while Transformers excel at sequence modeling but incur high computational and memory overhead. We introduce BiHDTrans, an efficient neurosymbolic binary hyperdimensional Transformer that integrates self-attention into the HD computing paradigm, unifying the representational efficiency of HD computing with the temporal modeling power of Transformers. Empirically, BiHDTrans outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) HD computing models by at least 14.47% and achieves 6.67% higher accuracy on average than SOTA binary Transformer

translated_title: BiHDTrans：用于高效多变量时间序列分类的二进制超维Transformer
translated_abstract: 物联网（IoT）设备的激增产生了前所未有的多变量时间序列（MTS）数据量，需要在资源受限的边缘环境中进行高效且准确的处理以实现及时决策。超维（HD）计算凭借其固有的高效性和可并行性，在分类任务中展现出潜力，但难以捕捉复杂的时间模式；而Transformer虽然擅长序列建模，但会带来高昂的计算和内存开销。我们提出了BiHDTrans，一种高效的神经符号二进制超维Transformer，它将自注意力机制集成到HD计算范式中，将HD计算的表示效率与Transformer的时间建模能力统一起来。实验表明，BiHDTrans的性能比最先进（SOTA）的HD计算模型高出至少14.47%，平均准确率比SOTA二进制Transformer高出6.67%。
tldr: BiHDTrans将自注意力机制融入超维计算范式，提出了一种二进制超维Transformer，在多变量时间序列分类任务中实现了高效性与准确性的统一，性能显著超越现有HD计算模型和二进制Transformer。
en_tdlr: BiHDTrans integrates self-attention into the hyperdimensional computing paradigm to create an efficient binary hyperdimensional Transformer that unifies HD computing's representational efficiency with Transformer's temporal modeling power, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art HD models and binary Transformers in multivariate time series classification.
